name: com.atthree.wobblefolk.lookat
description: Layered procedural look-at for characters: eyes lead, head follows, shoulders and torso catch up. Works on animated characters (Transform driver) and physics active ragdolls (ConfigurableJoint driver).

samples.description: Primitive character with a look chain (torso, chest, neck, head, eyes) following the mouse. Keys 1/2/3 switch presets, I toggles interest points, L locks the gaze on a random object. Uses the active render pipeline default shader.
